checks.required_behavior: The insights gate must read only the 'insights' purpose so a 'promotions' choice cannot satisfy it.
checks.observed_code_behavior: enabled() selects the latest choices row WHERE owner=? AND purpose=? with the caller-supplied purpose; no row yields False. Insights and promotions are distinct purpose values, so a promotions row cannot satisfy an insights query.

anchors.explanation: Exact (owner,purpose) lookup; default False when no matching row.

checks.required_behavior: Insights processing requires a specific affirmative choice; default state is off.
checks.observed_code_behavior: No choices row => enabled() returns False (off). preference() accepts only value in ('on','off') and stores int(value=='on'); the UI submits an explicit 'on' only via the per-purpose switch form.

anchors.explanation: Per-purpose switch form submits explicit on/off value.

checks.required_behavior: Each insights choice is recorded with a version.
checks.observed_code_behavior: choices schema has version and at columns; preference() inserts VERSION constant and UTC timestamp with each row.

anchors.explanation: choices table stores purpose, value, version, at.
VERSION constant written into each choice.

checks.required_behavior: Campaign/promotion path must use only 'promotions' purpose, never 'insights'.
checks.observed_code_behavior: eligible_campaign() reads enabled(owner,'promotions') and objection only; drain 'promotion' branch uses eligible_campaign. No insights purpose consulted for promotions.

anchors.explanation: Eligibility uses promotions and objection purposes only.

checks.required_behavior: Insights/report processing runs only when insights consent is enabled.
checks.observed_code_behavior: drain 'report' branch requires enabled(owner,'insights'); report action requires enabled(who,'insights') before queueing.

anchors.explanation: Report job executes only if insights enabled.

checks.target: Core application available without insights consent (store.py:0065-0083; views.py:0031-0032)
checks.required_behavior: Application submission and case handling must not depend on insights consent.
checks.observed_code_behavior: submit() validates only application fields and inserts the case; no choices/enabled reference. Dashboard application form requires no consent checkbox.

anchors.explanation: Application form fields contain no consent requirement.

output.summary: All in-scope targets are supported by the supplied source. enabled() reads the latest choices row for the exact (owner,purpose) pair, so insights and promotions are separate purposes and a promotions row cannot satisfy the insights gate; absence of a row yields off (affirmative opt-in). preference() persists a versioned, timestamped record and restricts purposes/values. Insights processing (report action and drain 'report' branch) is gated on enabled(...,'insights'); campaign eligibility uses only 'promotions'/'objection'. Core application submission and the dashboard form have no consent dependency, so the core app remains available with insights off. Static source reading only; no execution performed.
